notes: Monthly submission-count feature build: DATA steps parse SubmissionStatusDate (datepart), drop blank dates, extract year/month, then a group-by count rolls up per Year/Month and mdy()+monyy7. builds a Date column. Kept the author's DATA-step logic verbatim; translated the Viya CAS scaffolding (cas session, caslib, proc casutil promote/save) away and expressed proc fedsql as proc sql, with casuser.submissions replaced by a 10-row sample (one blank-date row) inlined at the top of script.sas so the bundle is self-contained. autoexec.sas holds only options obs=100.
